template.name: Altitude Hold Checkpoint
template.description: Take off directly to the working altitude, hold heading and hover while the sensor pod stabilises. Graded on reaching the altitude during the flight.
template.content: Command {drone_name} to take off to {random_alt:22:30:1} meters and hold that altitude, hovering in place while the sensor pod stabilises. The drone reaches its cruise height in the take-off itself; there is no second climb.
content_aliases: Command {drone_name} to take off to {random_alt:22:30:1} meters and hold that altitude, hovering in place while the sensor pod stabilises. The drone reaches its cruise height in the take-off itself; there is no second climb.
